charts.description: uPlot chart renderer reading pure-data series from innfo-model.series{chartId:number[]}; x-axis months window from meta.months/historyMonths/startMonth/startYear.

feedback-export.description: Reviewer suggest/edit drafts in localStorage and the Export modal with identifier gate, instructions and agent-prompt tabs, timestamped JSON download.

concept-rail.description: Left rail of template concepts with per-concept element counts.

fulltext-search.description: Search box filtering element names and field values.

matrix-grids.description: Matrix sections rendered as rows-by-cols tables from the model slots.

hash-routing.description: In-page relationship links resolving to element anchors via location hash.

reference-popup.description: Reference-typed field values render as pills that open a detail dialog with the referenced element's info (name, concept, description, fields).

document-view.description: Generic readable-document renderer: builds a tree from parent/next fields and renders each root chain as a document (root + steps with concept colors and step-type icons).

guided-procedure.description: Guided Procedure Execution (fsm-stepper): navigable tree of root Work elements and their step chains with condition guards, I/O, tools, and role assignment.

timeline-grid.description: Interactive monthly P&L and metrics timeline grid with growth rules, variable overrides, formula recalculation, and CSV export.
